visual_review.q2: Both learned models remain close, with soft shadow structure. No clear new winner.
visual_review.sony: Fuselage/windows remain soft; the two learned models are close. No clear new winner.
visual_review.gfx50r: Both learned models show sharper seams and more visible surface variation than RawNIND; without clean GT, not all retained variation can be called detail. The two learned methods remain close.
visual_review.fabric_example: All methods miss fine cords. Fresh no-context10000 has a more yellow/darker cast than V43/GT on this particular crop.
visual_review.building_example: Both learned models show cleaner architectural edges than RawNIND, with remaining cloud/detail loss. Not a full-suite ranking.

decision.next: Finish S/B and full matched numerical/native/analytic/GFX review before attributing differences or selecting a recipe.
